title: Add Tdarr matrix scratch library generator
summary: Add a developer tool that materializes the downloaded Tdarr sample inventory into a scratch-hosted Movies and TV diagnostic library using hardlinks, manifests, and a generated test config.
reason: The Tdarr sample cache is large and should remain immutable; hardlinked scratch libraries provide repeatable movie/TV parser, queue, route, container, codec, and audio test inputs without physically duplicating the corpus.
behavior_before: Tdarr samples existed only as a local fixture cache and had to be selected or renamed manually before pipeline validation.
behavior_after: A repeatable CLI creates the scratch TdarrMatrix test library, manifest evidence, and explicit movie/tv LibraryProfiles config without editing live operator config or mutating the canonical Tdarr cache.
manual_validation: real TdarrMatrix materialization - 2316 Movies, 2316 TV, 4632 manifest rows, 0 missing targets, generated files ignored
rollback_plan: Delete src/mediapipeline/tools/dev/materialize_tdarr_test_library.py, tests/python/tooling/test_materialize_tdarr_test_library.py, this change packet, and any generated ignored LocalBase/Scratch/TestLibraries/TdarrMatrix runtime library.
notes: Generated LocalBase/Scratch/TestLibraries/TdarrMatrix with 2316 Movies hardlinks, 2316 TV hardlinks, 4632 manifest rows, and explicit movie/tv LibraryProfiles.
